head_commit.message:
dft runs split: the build in its own job (task 8e55f343, verifier#208)

Run 45012852925 (#208, one job, 4 Lake workers): the shim built 771 chain targets one after the other, 259 minutes in
total with about 10 s of Lake start-up per call, and the 335-minute deadline killed the Lean unit (330.6 min) right
after the build: the export, the kernel replay and the audit got no time (memory 52%, so time, not memory). Split: job 1
makes one parallel lake build, job 2 has its own 335 minutes for the check. The dft233 entrypoint keeps its own one-job
profile (profiles/dft233.json); a PR run never splits. The site pins the profile, so the site trust commit changes
profiles[dft] with it. Tests that used dft as the one-job example use apsp.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
